cold_start_order: 1. Existing privilege/task/IRQ-mask guard and read-only preflight. Always check selected vectors; inspect powered pads/peripherals only when their gates prove observable. Reject foreign SPI4 gate/reset/kernel mux. Do not probe DMA/DMAMUX behind gateoff.

2. Existing System starts fixed HSI64/cacheoff/TIM2. Do not tighten general System for unrelated peripherals. D1 performs actual exactDEV450/REV2003/defaulttrim admission; authored policy cannot observe silicon. Non-V/trim failure after System start must unwind actual effects honestly.
3. Acquire exclusive SPI4/selected GPIO gates and ONE added-bit shared DMA1EN lease; DSB+readback before any DMA probe. No separate DMAMUX1EN or global DMA reset.

4. Check ALL selected lanes after shared gate on, before pin snapshot/controller prepare. UART0/1 retain existing CR/mux cold predicates. SPI2/3 require D1 full idle CR/NDTR/PAR/M0AR/M1AR/FCR/mux/owned-flag conditions. Every selected IRQ checked, not the last chosen lane. Rejection rolls back only newly added gates, with readback.
5. Admit every selected bank/pad/LCKR before capturing any pin lease, then capture selected fields including PE11. Later foreign pad cannot authorize restoring an earlier unadmitted pin.

6. SPI prepare binds static state/endpoint/CS; initializes CS high and readback, routes PE12/13/14 AF5, THEN calls D1 initialize (requires AF5 already ready). D1 owns SCK idle/reset and three IRQ effects; no duplicated wire state machine.

7. Existing retain_on_failed_init and initialized-index include partial constructor before prepare. Stop unclaimed D1 does zero hardware writes; if CS had an actual partial effect its cleanup still runs. Partial D1 init drains genuinely or preserves responsibility/remaining effects.
stop_and_shared_lifetime: D1 stop with active loan returns BUSY, without implicit cancel. Caller explicitly cancels/continues bounded service and retries stop; Platform must not copy older UART auto-cancel expectations into D1.

No active loan but retained D1 stop advances bounded cleanup across calls; only actual SUCCESS decrements Platform initialized index. Do not use synchronous polling drain/finish_clock/retain_and_park on async service.

If either SPI or UART remains borrowed/draining/QUARANTINED, no shared DMA1 gate/System/time/cache/pin release. Observed cache/clock taint is sticky; restoring a bit cannot restore coherence or revoke a loan.

After all selected controllers join, existing masked GPIO restore uses readbacks. D1 selected CS-high/SCK handoff/reset precedes Board restore; restored original mode is not promised to keep a product safe output.

Then clear only assembly-added DMA1EN. Failed withdrawal retains contribution/System for actual retry; pre-existing gate stays enabled. Unselected stream/mux/flags and unrelated pre-existing DMA activity are preserved. Never reset all DMA1.
Release other gates and System last. Keep original primary/cleanup/remaining-effects/diagnostics and request first terminal cause. SETTLED remains provider final access.
